messages:
sanjay: Quick heads-up — starting a golden refresh tied to the q6b-int4 quant bring-up. Need curation + dedupe + labeler handoff. ETA for seed set is EOD today.

marta: SGTM. how big is the target golden?

sanjay: aiming for 2.5k golden rows total: 1.5k multilang edgecases + 1k core english. We want stratified slices: question, instruction, code, dialog.

olivia: can we avoid overlap w/ last refresh? last set had ~12% near-dupes with anchorbank.

sanjay: yes — dedupe step will use fingerprint + fuzzyhash. plan: drop samples with >0.92 sim to existing golden and anchorbank.

marta: paste the sampler query so ops can run it in staging.

sanjay: here, rough SQL we will run (staging):
```sql
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT id, text, lang, similarity(fingerprint, anchor_fp) as sim 
  FROM samplebank 
  WHERE model_label_coverage >= 0.8
)
SELECT * FROM candidates WHERE sim < 0.92 ORDER BY rand() LIMIT 2500;
```

ira: nice. labeling note — current annotator throughput is ~120/hr, but we expect 20% slower for multilang. timeline looks like 3 business days for 2.5k if we prioritize.

labeler-bot: @labeler-team queue created: golden-q-1745012345. 2500 items enqueued. SLA: 72h for initial pass.

olivia: eval plan? we should run a canary eval on production variant + quant to catch regressions before flipping routes.

sanjay: agreed. metrics: exact-match on anchor QA, perplexity delta on holdout, hallucination rate on a 200-item microgolden. If any metric regresses >3% we pause rollout.

marta: can devex run the canary and post the result to this thread? small checklist: 1) run canary on q6b-int4 with batch=8 2) run microgolden eval 3) publish artifact w/ seed list id

devex-bot: Canary job queued: job_id=canary-1745012345-q6b. Will post results to #eng-ml/canary-results when done.

ira: one more curation ask — include a 100-item adversarial slice (prompt priors known to break int4) so labelers tag hallucinations specifically.

sanjay: good call — adding adversarial slice (100) and 100 deid-sensitive candidates to triage list. will update the enqueue job.

marta: thanks. i'll coordinate annotator priority with ira, and we should sync tomorrow 10am PT if anything is delayed.

sanjay: perfect. tagging @marta @ira for the handoff. will drop the final seedset id once the staging run is clean. :thumbsup:
